scope: Many fixes for empty lists, blank items and damaged files, in every part of the app.

topics.title: A way out of a stuck web dialog
details: Some web pages show a box that will not close.
Press Escape twice on that box. The web browser menu opens, so you can go on.

topics.title: Choose text by word, line or to the end in documents
details: You can now extend a selection, or select to the end of a line, in documents and emails.
Before, some of these were typed into your text.

topics.title: Speech, startup and Help
details: After Pause, speech comes back when you press a key or give a command.
If the voice fails to restart once, Companion tries again later instead of staying silent.
Companion starts even if the speech settings file is damaged.
F1 repeats the update question when the microphone is off.
Help with e-mail finds the email topic. Help, please works on the main menu.
The speech transcript keeps every line, even when an old copy is open.
Options are saved more safely.
The guide no longer mentions a setting that was removed.

topics.title: Email
details: Emails that hold only a picture now read their words.
A blank sender is read as Unknown sender, not as symbols.
Accented letters, like the e in Cafe, are read correctly.
Message numbers in an empty folder say Empty list.
A reply to a message with no subject no longer says no subject in its subject line.
A damaged Options file no longer stops the inbox.
A removed account tells you to say add account.
A save cut short no longer leaves a fake draft in your list.
Newsletters sent to hidden readers say No To address.

topics.title: Calendar and Contacts
details: Contacts saved on this computer are never lost when the file is damaged, held or saved by Notepad.
A date that does not exist, like February 30, is named and asked again.
Events that end after midnight say the next day when they do not start today.
Deleting the last contact keeps you in the same list.
A removed calendar or address book is named correctly.
With no calendar to save in, adding an event says why and keeps you where you were.
Control+L and Email with no match give clear answers.

topics.title: Documents, notes and files
details: Selecting in an empty document or note says there is no text to select.
A line of only spaces is read as Empty paragraph.
Emails you write say Beginning of message and End of message.
Damaged Word files say what to do next, in plain words.
A damaged Word file keeps you on the file you picked.
If you turned off reading a file when it opens, that now works for all files.
Select previous paragraph no longer skips one.
In File manager, Delete and Rename keep your place.
A new name like Name tags is kept whole.

topics.title: Web
details: Your own Chrome comes back when Companion closes, even if it was hidden.
An empty table says This table is empty.
A download folder on a USB drive is named, like drive E.
Main menu during Chrome setup tells you how to set it up later.
Submit form tells you when the page has turned off its Send button.
Review form on a page with no fields says so.

topics.title: Radio, podcasts and the player
details: Seek and chapter keys with nothing playing tell you to choose a station or episode first.
With no presets, Play preset says how to save one.
Empty lists of shows, downloads and recordings say what to do next.
A station number past the end says how many stations there are.
Only sound files are listed as recordings.
Subscribing to a show you already have says so.
Space answers Yes or No questions on Radio and Podcasts.
Escape tips name the list you go back to.
When you set a recording for 12 AM, you hear that midnight tonight is 12 AM tomorrow.
With no internet, radio search tells you to check your connection.
